info.name: FinMarket-Enterprise | Phase I Complete API & Integration Tests
info.description: One consolidated Postman collection plus the user-confirmed subsequent processDelivery() recovery edit. Run in folder order against a freshly restarted Phase I in-memory backend. Success cases establish reusable IDs; negative cases verify HTTP error contracts. No real emails or Facebook posts are sent. See folder descriptions, especially Diagnostics, for known source-level issues. Auth is Phase I demo with no JWT. API requests are local and unauthenticated. Run in Postman Collection Runner, sequentially (not parallel). On subsequent runs, the setup request refreshes runTag to avoid duplicate email errors. Restart backend to reset RAM.
